        <script><![CDATA[var OCRotaICalendarUIBSNC = Class.create();
OCRotaICalendarUIBSNC.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.OCRotaICalendarSNC, {

	initialize: function() {
		global.OCRotaICalendarSNC.prototype.initialize.call(this);
	},

	getMemberCalendarUIPageURL: function (groupId, rotaId, userId) {
		if (global.JSUtil.nil(groupId) || global.JSUtil.nil(rotaId) || global.JSUtil.nil(userId)) return null;
		var instanceName = gs.getProperty("instance_name");
		var fallbackURL = "https://" + instanceName + ".service-now.com/";
		var baseURL = gs.getProperty("glide.servlet.uri", fallbackURL);
		var calendarUIPageURL = baseURL + "nav_to.do?uri=" + encodeURIComponent("/$calendar_invite?groupId=" + groupId + "&rotaId=" + rotaId + "&userId=" + userId);
		return calendarUIPageURL;
	},

    type: 'OCRotaICalendarUIBSNC'
});]]></script>
